summary.text: Johnny Rye is serving his fifth term in the Arkansas House, representing District 36.

paragraphs.text: He served as Poinsett County assessor from 1991 to 2016 and is a graduate of Arkansas State University.
During much of that time, he served on the board and the legislative committee of the Association of Arkansas Counties.
